name: St Andrews Golf Club
foot: Automatic page (not hand checked): course from OpenStreetMap, card from golfify, trees / long grass / water from the vision layer on USDA NAIP + USGS 3DEP lidar, OB inferred from the course outline and buildings. Solved tee sets: Black, Blue. See qa_report.md for the hole-by-hole checks.

15: Routing/tees fine. Black calm pick 4-wood aimed 40 yds left lands 286 yds out at the inside of the dogleg-left corner, at the cart path with trees left/long (51% trees/water/OB in the pattern).
16: Black tee was walked back 28 yds from the Blue box to match the 419 card yardage, which puts it on the 15th green (11 m from the 15th green centre).
